citations.quote: Tests use the in-memory store by default.

note: A path instead of an alias (docs/setup.md is T2-001's path; kept under the 16 code point alias limit so LIMIT-001 does not fire first); f1, a local key the response defines, which a citation's item doesn't accept (ALIAS-003, as in §3.2.1); F-2, a well-formed finding alias that is not in the table (CIT-001, not ALIAS-003: ALIAS-003 needs an alias that exists). One valid citation keeps the finding.
